# Sweep the 13.2 notes' merges since cec2fcce84

## Context

The 13.2 notes (`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md`) were last swept up to `cec2fcce84` by #19431 (PR #19432, merged 2026-10-06). The [#14800 cut list](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-5815935089) keeps that commit as the start of the sweep at the cut, and the cut has not happened. Measured at `d75cc68543`, `dev` has 23 first-parent merges after #19432. 13 change engine source (`src/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, the package build), 3 only tests, 4 bump dependencies, and 3 touch agent substrate (`.codex/`, `learn/agentos/`).

Sweeps:
- **Live:** the latest 20 open neo issues at 2026-10-09T05:20Z; no equivalent.
- **A2A:** the latest 30 messages, all read states; no claim on the notes.
- **Memory Core:** "13.2 release notes iteration sweep…", 5 results; the cut list sets the method, and nothing contradicts it.
- **Own assignments:** #14800 (the parent) and #15000 (unrelated).

## The Problem

The 13 engine merges from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-08 have no disposition in the notes. Their subjects name changes a 13.2 user can see:
- VDom: settlement failures isolated from newer work (#19479); every disjoint batch root protected (#19468).
- Dock Layouts and the Workstation: converted popups stay under the pointer (#19458); closed popup widgets return once (#19464); a tear-out without a cross-window sort group says so (#19449); the tour enters through `resetTopology` (#19443); distinct header handle boundaries in drag (#19466); a grid keeps its scroll extent before a header lift (#19463); the dashboard demo's header proof and tour cues (#19469).
- Components and data: the DateSelector's day-view rebuild defers during a month transition (#19447); workspace connection URLs resolve from the document base (#19435).
- Portal: the `dist/development` and `dist/production` tabs open DevIndex's own entries (#19434).
- Package: source-only npm packages are validated (#19471), next to the package chapter's claim that the package ships no generated bundles.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md` is the authored path that `publish.mjs` reads (`release-notes-workflow.md` §6).
- **The #14800 cut list sets the method:** a line for each merge that changes what a 13.2 user sees, an upgrade row for each behaviour change, and everything else in the Full Changelog. The scope is engine-only (ruling of 2026-09-23).

## The Fix

One iteration PR on `v13.2.0.md`:
1. Disposition every first-parent merge after #19432 in `cec2fcce84..<PR base>`: a chapter line with its PR link, an upgrade row, or the Full Changelog. Each line is written from its PR, never from the subject alone.
2. Re-read the claim-reply line's live state (cut list item 7) and bound it again.
3. Move the banner to "iteration 6 of N", and move the cut list's sweep point to the PR base.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every first-parent merge in the window is dispositioned, and the PR body gives the count for each disposition.
- [ ] Every new claim links its PR and matches what the PR changed.
- [ ] The claim-reply line states the live state, with a link or a bound.
- [ ] The banner reads iteration 6, and the #14800 cut list names the new sweep point.
- [ ] A cross-family review approves before the merge.

## Out of Scope

- **The cut itself:** designations, final counts, and re-pointing `blob/dev` links to the tag (the #14800 cut list).
- **A fresh pages dry run at the cut commit:** #19047's recipe, asked of its author.
- **The Brain and Institution lines:** each writes its own notes.
